categories.label: Rookies
categories.collectorIntent: First-year cards and rookie-designated chase cards.

categories.label: Case Hits / SSPs
categories.collectorIntent: Low-frequency or short-printed cards that breakers and collectors actively hunt.

categories.label: Parallels
categories.collectorIntent: Color/finish variations of base or insert cards.

categories.label: Numbered
categories.collectorIntent: Serial-numbered scarcity. Never infer numbering; use only verified product data.

categories.label: Memorabilia
categories.collectorIntent: Relic/memorabilia content, with autograph hybrids also tagged autograph.

categories.label: Inserts
categories.collectorIntent: Named non-base subsets that may range from common to rare.

categories.label: Base / Core
categories.collectorIntent: Core checklist cards. Useful for completeness but usually lower hunt priority than the categories above.

classificationRules: A card may have multiple tags, e.g. rookie + autograph + numbered.
Case hit/SSP status must be verified from a reputable checklist/product source.
Serial numbering must be stored exactly as verified and never guessed from parallel names.
2024 Select XRC cards remain product-checklist records but are excluded from 2024 Team Hunt player eligibility.
Team Hunt display order should favor collector-intent categories above generic base cards.
